profile.name: TCP原始通信组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用作通过 TCP 与实验室仪器建立网络连接的通用基类。它负责初始化和关闭套接字连接、检查连接是否打开，以及发送和接收原始字节数据，适合为基于网络协议的仪器驱动提供底层通信能力。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that serves as a generic base class for connecting to laboratory instruments over TCP. It handles socket initialization and shutdown, checks whether the connection is open, and sends and receives raw byte data, providing low-level transport functionality for network-based instrument drivers.

registry.name: Open Standard Tcp Raw
registry.description: Tcp Raw Driver是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、打开。支持Signal, Slot, finalize等操作。
